description: This file contains automated tests for the OpenClaw configuration file handling in a macOS environment, testing configuration path resolution, remote gateway URL parsing, config updates, and auditing mechanisms.

classes.name: OpenClawConfigFileTests
classes.description: A suite of tests validating the configuration file handling and environment interactions for OpenClaw in macOS.

methods.name: makeConfigOverridePath
methods.description: Generates a temporary path for configuration override testing.

methods.name: `config path respects env override`
methods.description: Tests that the configuration path correctly respects environment variable overrides.

methods.name: `remote gateway port parses and matches host`
methods.description: Verifies that remote gateway URLs are parsed properly and port matching works as intended.

methods.name: `set remote gateway url preserves scheme`
methods.description: Ensures that updating the remote gateway URL preserves its original URL scheme.

methods.name: `clear remote gateway url removes only url field`
methods.description: Checks that clearing the remote gateway URL only removes the URL, preserving other fields.

methods.name: `state dir override sets config path`
methods.description: Tests that setting an override directory affects configuration file location.

methods.name: `save dict appends config audit log`
methods.description: Validates that saving configuration data correctly appends an audit log with details of the operation.

methods.name: `load dict audits suspicious out-of-band clobbers`
methods.description: Ensures loading configuration detects out-of-band modifications and records appropriate audits.
